elena (docs): Hey team — drafting a migration note for Dedicated regional failover + tenant sharding. Posting a quick prototype of the Terraform + SDK snippet, need quick sanity check before I open the PR :wave
ryan (eng): LGTM overall. A couple notes: reserved_pool config needs 'region_priority' doc'd; isolation annotation example should show both soft and hard isolation.
sam (platform): Also add a note about SLA behavior when using failover — fallback region incurs N+1 latency and billing behavior. cc @megan (product) for wording
megan (product): We should avoid promising cross-region SLAs; suggest phrasing: 'best-effort failover; observed latencies may exceed SLA thresholds; use Dedicated Multi-Region for guaranteed cross-region SLOs'
elena (docs): Good call. Also I added a small Python SDK snippet — can you check param names? ```py
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.reserve_pool(name='tenant-a', region='us-west-2', gpu_type='a100', capacity=8)
```
ryan (eng): param is 'gpu_profile' not 'gpu_type'. Also method returns job id; add example for waiting on completion: ```py
job = client.reserve_pool(name='tenant-a', region='us-west-2', gpu_profile='a100-80gb', capacity=8)
client.wait_job(job.id)
```
megan (product): For SLA section, add a short bullet callout: 'Active region SLA vs failover behavior' — docs team prefers concise prose/callout rather than a massive table.
elena (docs): I'll update. One more: links are stale to 'reserved-pools' page — the doc should link to /docs/dedicated/reserved-pools not /handbook/reserved. Anyone know the canonical path?
sam (platform): canonical is /docs/platform/dedicated/reserved-pools. Also add a terraform example for tenant labels: ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "tenant_a" {
  name = "tenant-a"
  region = "us-west-2"
  capacity_gpus = 8
  tenant_labels = ["team:search","env:prod"]
}
```
elena (docs): Perfect. I'll open PR with:
- updated SLA wording
- SDK snippet fix
- Terraform sample
- link fixes
- short migration checklist
ETA this afternoon.
ryan (eng): I'll review once PR is open. Quick Q: should we include an example showing eviction_policy 'no-evict' vs 'preemptible'? add short note.
elena (docs): yes. I'll include a small callout and a one-sentence recommendation to avoid 'preemptible' for latency-sensitive tenants.
deploy-bot: reminder: docs CI will run linkcheck on PRs.
megan (product): thanks all :thumbsup:
